title: AL Migration Manifest
description: Schema for migration.json — Business Central data-migration manifest that transfers ownership of tables/fields from a releasing extension to a receiving extension (on-premises only).

apprules.description: List of rules pointing to the ID(s) of the receiving extension(s) that tables and fields are moved to.

id.description: App ID (GUID) of the receiving extension that the tables/fields are moved to.
